Mehnat/mashina: F2 da yo‘q {n} qator nor.en: Labour/machines: {n} rows not in F2 follow by norm at estimate price ({s}) — included in the total.

Oldin smeta narxida yozilgan «Fakt = F2».en: There are {n} earlier “Actual = F2” documents written at estimate prices — their rows will not switch to F2 prices.

Quyidagi {n} ta «Fakt = F2» hujjati beko.ru: Отменить следующие документы «Факт = Ф2» ({n})? Затем откройте «Факт = Ф2» снова — запись пойдёт по цене Ф2.
Quyidagi {n} ta «Fakt = F2» hujjati beko.en: Cancel the following {n} “Actual = F2” documents? Then reopen “Actual = F2” — it will be written at F2 prices.

{n} ta eski «Fakt = F2» hujjati bekor qi.ru: Отменено старых документов «Факт = Ф2»: {n} — откройте «Факт = Ф2» снова.
{n} ta eski «Fakt = F2» hujjati bekor qi.en: {n} old “Actual = F2” documents cancelled — reopen “Actual = F2”.

F2 narxlari yuklanmadi — «Fakt = F2» och.en: F2 prices failed to load — “Actual = F2” was not opened. Please try again.

Istisno qilingan mehnat/mashina: {n} qat.en: Excluded labour/machine rows: {n} — they do not follow the work share copied from F2 and will not reach actuals ({s} not in the total).

Fakt F2 dan ko‘p: {n} qator ({s}) — tops.ru: Факт больше Ф2: строк — {n} ({s}) — несданные работы, не изменяются.
Fakt F2 dan ko‘p: {n} qator ({s}) — tops.en: Actuals exceed F2: {n} rows ({s}) — work not yet handed over, left unchanged.

1:1: {n} ta F2 satri → {n} ta fakt qator.en: 1:1: {n} F2 rows → {n} actual rows (volume, price and amount exact, with source)

F2 dagi minus qatorlar: {n} — hujjatdagi.en: Minus rows in F2: {n} — written as negative, exactly as in the document.

Tasdiqlangan F2 qatorlari ishorasi, hajm.en: Approved F2 rows are copied exactly — with sign, volume and price (minus rows too). Rows where actuals exceed F2 are left unchanged.
